description: This file declares the IMediaKeysIpcFactory interface, a factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances for IPC in the Rialto media framework. It includes method declarations for creating factory instances and media keys objects, and references external classes like IMediaKeys.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create IMediaKeys instances for IPC in the Rialto client.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMediaKeys object for the specified key system.
